Teaching August – December 2025

Visiting Faculty — Design Thinking, Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya

Image 1 of 7

Invited as visiting faculty at Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya (GSV), a Central University under the Ministry of Railways, to teach the Design Thinking course to first-year B.Tech students.

The engagement involved two large cohorts of over 70 students each, presenting the pedagogical challenge of maintaining hands-on inquiry and active engagement at scale.

The course introduced students to human-centred design principles, empathy mapping, problem framing, ideation, and iterative prototyping as tools applicable to engineering and infrastructure contexts.
